sections.Profile:
Sky Rider and Hi-Flyer are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Chicago Coin in 1974, featuring a hot air ballooning theme. Sky Rider is the four-player version, while Hi-Flyer accommodates two players.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Aviation, Two player, Sports, Original Theme, Hot air baloons, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Christian Marche
- Design: Wendell McAdams
- Design: Jerry Koci

- Sky Rider: released 1974-10-01, model number 439
- Hi-Flyer: released 1974-08-01, model number 442
